optimized_sql:
WITH store_hot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    AND date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
  JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
),
catalog_hot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    AND date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
  JOIN customer ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
),
web_hot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    AND date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
  JOIN customer ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM store_hot s
JOIN catalog_hot c
  ON (s.c_last_name, s.c_first_name, s.d_date) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, c.d_date)
JOIN web_hot w
  ON (s.c_last_name, s.c_first_name, s.d_date) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (w.c_last_name, w.c_first_name, w.d_date)
LIMIT 100
